label: Public-estimate factors. NOT GreenPixie data.
note: GreenPixie does not publish per-model or per-token factors, so these are order-of-magnitude assumptions for a coaching signal, not an inventory figure. Swap in vendor-measured factors by replacing this file; the shape stays the same.
unit: energy in Wh per output token; input tokens are a fraction of that

medium.examples: sonnet, gpt-5.x, default for unknown models

sources: Mistral Large 2 lifecycle assessment with ADEME and Carbone 4: about 1.14 gCO2e per 400-token reply (includes training and hardware share)
Google, Aug 2025: median Gemini text prompt about 0.24 Wh
OpenAI, 2025: typical ChatGPT query about 0.34 Wh
Ember / IEA: global average grid about 445 gCO2/kWh
